notes: Positioning only. This file is intentionally incomplete and is NOT valid against useCaseSchema yet.

Nothing in content/suggestions/ is loaded, validated, or rendered by the app — only content/published/* is. This draft therefore cannot appear on the live catalog, the Marketing business-area page, search, or the sitemap.
Do not copy to content/published/ until every entry in _fieldsToComplete is written from researched, verifiable information and the file passes `npm run validate:content`.
No performance claims, savings estimates, metrics, or implementation details have been written, because none are currently supported by researched content.

suggestion.title: Google Ads Performance Coach
suggestion.summary: Analyzes Google Ads and website performance data to identify wasted spend, tracking issues, underperforming campaigns, and the highest-priority improvements.
businessOutcomes: Make better advertising decisions and reduce wasted ad spend.

required_by_schema.industries: Which business types this is genuinely useful for. Must be non-empty.
required_by_schema.businessFunctions: Existing function labels, e.g. Marketing. Must be non-empty.
required_by_schema.businessProblem: The concrete problem in the owner's words. Candidate existing tag: improve-marketing-performance (confirm before asserting).
required_by_schema.businessProblems: One or more slugs from src/lib/business-problems.ts. Must be non-empty.
required_by_schema.outcome: Full outcome statement. Must not include invented savings percentages or metrics.
required_by_schema.expectedOutcomes: List form of the above. Must be non-empty.
required_by_schema.whoItsFor: Who should run this and who should not.
required_by_schema.requiredDataSources: Data-source slugs. No advertising or web-analytics data source exists in content/published/data-sources yet (see blocking_dependencies).
required_by_schema.requiredData: The specific fields the workflow reads.
required_by_schema.aiInputs: What is sent to the model. Must be non-empty.
required_by_schema.aiOutputs: What the model returns. Must be non-empty.
required_by_schema.requiredApis: API slugs, must resolve to content/published/apis. No google-ads-api entry exists yet (see blocking_dependencies). Must be non-empty.
required_by_schema.implementationSteps: Ordered setup steps. Must be non-empty and verified against current provider documentation.
required_by_schema.systemBehavior: What the system does on each run, including human review points. Must be non-empty.
required_by_schema.risks: Real limitations, including the risk of acting on incomplete conversion tracking. Must be non-empty.
required_by_schema.relatedUseCases: Slugs of existing use cases, e.g. local-seo-content-assistant if genuinely related.

optional.tagline: One-line hook, only if it adds information.

blocking_dependencies: content/published/apis/google-ads-api.json does not exist. requiredApis slugs must resolve to a published API entry, so the Google Ads API needs an entry (auth type, data available, actions supported, privacy notes) before this workflow can publish.
No advertising or website-analytics data source exists in content/published/data-sources. At least one is needed to describe where campaign and conversion data comes from.
on_publish_checklist: Move this file's `suggestion` object (fully completed) to content/published/use-cases/google-ads-performance-coach.json with the slug matching the filename.
Add the same area/process classification to the classifications map in scripts/backfill-business-areas.ts so the migration record stays accurate.
Confirm it renders once on /business-areas/marketing under Advertising with a Campaign Reporting label, and that Advertising leaves the 'More processes we're exploring' list.
